verdict.rationale: Open WebUI provides API keys (personal access tokens) and a role-based access control system (Admin/User/Pending) for authentication, but the evidence shows API keys simply mirror the full permissions of the underlying user account rather than being independently scoped per-agent tokens, and RBAC governs broad user roles rather than fine-grained least-privilege credential issuance for individual agents. missing for 10: evidence of per-key scopes/permissions, ability to restrict an API key to specific tools/endpoints, or agent-specific credential issuance separate from a user's full account access.
